tickets.title: Evaluate Paper Otter Life term policy lapse and reinstatement
tickets.text: Evaluate lapse and reinstatement options for Soren Cloudpuddle’s $750,000 20-year Paper Otter Life term policy following the draft failure after his checking account was replaced. Address the notice’s draft failure and the goal of preserving existing underwriting terms.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term coverage and disability protection
tickets.text: Review Soren Cloudpuddle’s term coverage and disability protection following Lila Cloudpuddle’s reduction to part-time work. Assess coverage needs in light of increased household dependence on his salary and the mortgage, childcare, and education-funding exposure.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
